segments.label: First load — cache miss to ready

messages.label: cache miss → one request per key
store the DTO under the key
retry with backoff · restore the snapshot

cards.title: The outbox role, adapted
items: there is no client-side outbox: a browser cannot durably enqueue work, so nothing is spooled for later delivery
the query cache is the only client-side state beyond the credential — in-memory, keyed, and lost on reload
the durable store is the server; the client is a reader with a cache

cards.title: The query layer owns the async path
items: the key is the cache identity: stable, serializable and carrying every input — ["leads", tenantId, { cursor, search }]
in-flight requests are deduplicated per key; after a mutation the layer invalidates by prefix instead of refetching the world
an abort signal rides the SDK call, so a route change cancels the request instead of racing it

cards.title: Failure is a state, not a crash
items: 5xx or a network error retries with backoff; rateLimited honours Retry-After
an optimistic write is snapshotted before it is applied and restored on failure — without both steps it is data loss with a spinner
the ViewModel maps the failure to the error state and shows the copyable correlation id
